solving simultaneous linear equations|ta.question: In a multiple choice test, 2 marks were awarded for each correct answer, 1 mark was deducted from each incorrect answer and 0 for not writing an answer. Anna answered 49 questions and scored 62 marks out of 100. Letting x be the number of correct answers and y be the number of incorrect answers, and using the inverse matrix method, determine the number of questions that Anna answered correctly.
